adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `type.replace('_', '-')` will only replace the first underscore because it’s a string-based replace. That means a type like `some_admin_model` would become `some-admin_model` and would not match an `ADMIN_MODELS` entry that’s fully dasherized (e.g. `some-admin-model`), causing `basePath` to incorrectly return `"/"` instead of `"/admin/"`. The diff doesn’t introduce any current admin model types with multiple underscores, so this isn’t a demonstrable break in this PR, but it is a real edge-case/robustness issue created by the change.
